title: State Department UAP Cable 5, Mexico, September 16, 2003
doc_notes: This document is a weekly political blotter cable from the U.S. Embassy in Mexico, which includes a summary of a Mexican Congressional hearing regarding UAP and alleged alien remains.

incidents.summary: Mexican pilots encountered fast-moving flying objects during flight, as presented in testimony to the Mexican Congress.
incidents.quote: videos of Mexican pilots' encounters with fast-moving flying objects during flight
